SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS hel_date,
       o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS n_distinct
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-29 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-03 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH o AS (
  SELECT o.*, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS hel_date
  FROM fact_web_order o
),
t AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE p.category='ZZ Test' OR f.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=999)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE hel_date=DATE '2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled') AS helsinki_noncancelled,
  COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FILTER (WHERE hel_date=DATE '2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled') AS distinct_noncancelled,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled') AS utc_noncancelled,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE hel_date=DATE '2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled' AND web_order_id IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM t)) AS test_orders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE hel_date=DATE '2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled' AND line_count IS NULL) AS null_lines,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE hel_date=DATE '2025-12-01') AS all_status
FROM o
